rule: Sam, 2026-11-17, relayed by COBIx on #3358 section 2: collect with gaps noted and confidence scores; Commons Clarity's Part B (#3480, comment 6967374303); COBIx's D2 decision (major total differs, about 30); Sam's routine prompt of 2026-11-25, as the S739 conductor's brief carries it: a record held for a gap is collected with its gap named and a lower score on the 0-100 bar, never held, unless the record is not the program's own; S739: Contra Costa's records kb/receipts/program_requirement_records_piles_s720_contracosta_2026-11-24_s720k.json held, read again by key: passed by a rescore where today's scorer's one reading moves them, else collected with their gaps named where the record is the program's own (no reread, no reconcile)

gaps.degree_summary_ge_none: The page's unit summary prints the degree total and prints its general education and electives as None or N/A, so the record holds the major alone; the major adds up to its printed major total.
gaps.noted_figures_differ: The reader's notes quote two figures from the catalog page that disagree, and the record's units add to one and state the other; no page read has settled which the program requires.

held.why: held: on no proved live run: no committed receipt posts its committed run (44687786167) to a live row (on_live_run); its live row's run is unknown here

held: its notes print general education as None and N/A and say nothing of its electives, so degree_summary_ge_none's sentence (general education and electives as None or N/A) is not its own (the second reader, S720), and no other kind's sentence is true of it
held: on no proved live run: no committed receipt posts its committed run (44687786167) to a live row (on_live_run); its live row's run is unknown here

records.words: Total units 19-22 taken from the header '19-22 Credits' and the Unit Summary 'Major or Area of Emphasis 19 / 22'. degree_total 60/60 taken from Unit Summary 'Total Program 60 / 60'; GE and electives rows print 'None'.
records.read_against: today's arithmetic (the filed one is an older scorer's and stays as filed)

blocks.name: Plus at least 9 units from any of the following lists (List A, List B, List C)

records.words: Core block heading states MUSIC-190A/B and 191A/B count .5 units each though ranges 0.5-5.5 are printed beside them; Major Instrument (2 units) and Ensemble (4 units) totals come from the block headings. | degree_total 60, ge_units 15-20 (General Education, Local) and electives 0-1 (needed to reach 60 unit degree minimum) come from the Program Unit Summary table; it also lists 3 units double counted.

program.ge_pattern: Contra Costa College Associate in Arts degree general education breadth requirements (local GE)

blocks.name: REQUIRED: Core Courses (.5 units each MUSIC-190A/B and MUSIC-191A/B)
REQUIRED: Major Instrument (4 semesters at .5 units each, for total of 2 units)
REQUIRED: Ensemble (4 semesters at 1 unit each, for total of 4 units)
Select from any of the following areas for a minimum of 18 units
Students not possessing freshman level musical knowledge or skills may be advised to enroll in some of the following classes after an entrance placement audition

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score (a passing row: checks.arithmetic to equal); checks.coverage, invented and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found, and a course an entry says the printed total leaves out on neither it nor the state's list. A note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.
